_about: Public-domain Morgan Dix (1827-1908), rector of Trinity Church, New York, for the Word Hoard: A Manual of Prayers, Lectures on the Pantheistic Idea, his exposition of Galatians and Colossians, The Book of Hours, Lectures on the Calling of a Christian Woman, The Oxford Movement, The Gospel and Philosophy, The Seven Deadly Sins, The Sacramental System, Blessing and Ban from the Cross, Three Guardians of Supernatural Religion, his History of the Parish of Trinity Church (4 vols.), his memoir of Mother Harriet Starr Cannon, and single sermons. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 94 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
